concept: Claude Code skill listing budget formula
summary: Docs: the budget scales at 1% of the model's context window; on overflow, descriptions drop starting with the least-invoked skills; every name stays.

facts.text: Docs: the budget scales at 1% of the model's context window; on overflow, descriptions drop starting with the least-invoked skills; every name stays.
The skills page says the Skills row in /context reports the listing after budget; a debug-log warning appears on overflow (existing dossier).
Exact formula, including how tokens convert to characters and why a name-only floor exists.

The skills docs state only the 1% of context window rule, the skillListingBudgetFraction setting, the SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET override and the 1,536-character per-entry cap; they give no characters-per-token factor or minimum
This claim set adds nothing beyond agent-skill-listing-injection-cost.md
